## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the organisation's IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of our server environments, networks, and supporting systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage both day-to-day operations and longer-term infrastructure planning.
## Key Responsibilities
- Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, software, and associated infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve server-related hardware and software malfunctions across workstations, servers, and communication infrastructure, providing timely service support to minimise disruption
- Monitor network performance and system health on an ongoing basis, identifying potential issues and making proactive adjustments to maintain service quality and reliability
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including operational procedures, system logs, configuration records, and IT policies and instructions
- Assess current and future infrastructure needs by regularly surveying existing systems and recommending enhancements to server capacity, network design, and technology implementation
- Ensure computer site design and layout allows all hardware and software components to integrate and function cohesively within the broader IT environment
- Manage system security measures including user access controls, patch management, antivirus solutions, and firewall configurations to protect organisational data and assets
- Plan, implement, and test backup and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard data integrity and ensure business continuity
- Administer and support databases, virtualisation platforms, and cloud-based services as required by the organisation
- Collaborate with IT team members, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve escalated technical issues
- Provide guidance and technical support to end users and junior IT staff, promoting best practices and ensuring effective use of systems and tools
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proven experience in a Systems Administrator or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
- Demonstrated experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall management
- Proficiency in virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions and the ability to develop and test recovery procedures
- Sound understanding of IT security principles, including access management, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and maintain accurate system records
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and work both autonomously and as part of a collaborative team
## Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud
- Familiarity with scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python for task automation
- ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within an ITIL-aligned service management framework
- Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 administration
- Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Nagios, PRTG, or SolarWinds
- Prior experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environment
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative IT team that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and professional growth

- Enjoy a flexible working environment that promotes a healthy work-life balance, including hybrid working arrangements where applicable

About the role
The Senior GRC Security Consultant leads governance, risk and compliance (GRC) engagements for Spartans Security clients, providing expert advice and hands-on delivery across security strategies, control frameworks (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ASD Essential Eight), risk assessment, incident response uplift, policy development, and security program roadmaps. The role operates in a CISO-as-a-Service capacity across multiple customers, building stakeholder trust, uplifting security posture and ensuring alignment with regulatory and industry requirements.

Core Tasks and Duties
•	Independently scope and deliver security GRC engagements including assessments against ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and ASD Essential Eight; develop remediation roadmaps and maturity uplift plans.
•	Conduct cyber governance, risk and compliance activities, including assessing cyber risks, reviewing security controls, and ensuring alignment with security frameworks, standards, and best practices.
•	Lead or contribute to cyber security assessments, including control effectiveness reviews, gap analyses, compliance reviews, and the development of security standards, policies and guidelines.
•	Analyse and investigate cyber security incidents and breaches, performing root cause analysis, assessing impact, and recommending corrective actions to strengthen future resilience.
•	Monitor security alerts, threat intelligence, logs and events, identifying potential security risks and undertaking threat hunting activities to detect malicious activity or vulnerabilities.
•	Coordinate and lead incident response operations, including containment, eradication, recovery and post incident reporting, and manage collaboration across internal and external teams.
•	Develop and maintain cyber security architecture, ensuring secure design principles are applied across systems, networks and cloud environments, and recommending improvements based on emerging threats.
•	Provide specialist cyber security advice and guidance to senior leaders, project teams and business stakeholders on security strategy, risk mitigation and security best practices.
•	Implement, review and uplift security controls, including identity and access management (IAM), network security, endpoint protection, vulnerability management and cloud security controls.
•	Coordinate Security Operations Centre (SOC) functions, including case management, escalation handling, SIEM/SOAR workflows and ongoing monitoring improvements.
•	Support the development and implementation of cyber policies, procedures and documentation, including incident response plans, standard operating procedures, audit evidence and compliance reports, ensuring alignment to customer risk appetite and regulatory obligations (e.g., APRA CPS 234, SOCI where applicable).
•	Participate in internal and external cyber security audits, coordinating activities, preparing documentation, responding to findings and ensuring continuous improvement.
•	Deliver cyber awareness and training support, helping improve cyber maturity across the organisation by coaching staff on cyber risks and secure practices.
•	Accept responsibility for the processes, procedures and operational management associated with system security and disaster recovery planning.
•	Analyse, recommend, install and maintain software security applications; monitor contractual obligations, performance delivery and service level agreements (SLAs).
•	Perform CISO-as-a-Service functions for multiple customers, including risk governance, executive reporting, board briefings and program oversight.
•	Review, uplift and test incident response plans; coordinate exercises and lessons-learned to strengthen cyber resilience.
•	Provide subject matter expertise on operational security processes (incident/vulnerability management, system hardening, security governance) across on-premises and cloud environments (e.g., Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS).
•	Maintain and govern Information Security Risk Registers; track treatments and drive timely remediation with accountable owners.
•	Define methodologies for identifying critical information assets and associated risks; perform business impact analyses and control mapping.
•	Lead stakeholder engagement with client executives, vendors and service providers; act as a trusted governance and assurance liaison.
•	Produce high-quality deliverables (assessment reports, statements of applicability, audit findings, metrics dashboards) and present outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Mentor junior consultants, contribute to service development and support the creation of new GRC offerings and reusable accelerators.
•	Support pre-sales activities including proposal input, level-of-effort estimation and solution design for GRC engagements.

Required Skills and Experience:
•	Demonstrated experience delivering senior-level GRC engagements across multiple industries (consulting or in-house).
•	Deep knowledge of security frameworks and regulatory standards (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ASD Essential Eight, PCI DSS; desirable: APRA CPS 234, SOCI).
•	Proficiency in security governance, risk assessment, control design, policy development and metrics/reporting.
•	Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including executive reporting.
•	Hands-on familiarity with enterprise and cloud environments (e.g., Microsoft AD, Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS) and common security controls (firewalls, EDR/SIEM, WAF, IAM).
•	Ability to work independently across concurrent engagements, meeting deadlines and quality expectations.

Qualifications & Experience?
•	Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
•	10+ years’ total experience in information security, including 4+ years in security consulting and/or GRC leadership roles.
•	Experience working within international or multinational organisations (particularly in the telecommunications or banking sectors) is highly regarded. 
•	Exposure to global security standards and cross-border GRC or cybersecurity programs across diverse geographic environments is strongly preferred.
•	Must hold at least three of the following relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer, and ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor.
•	Evidence of continuing professional development and familiarity with current threat and compliance landscapes.

Right to Work Requirement:
Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia at the time of application.  

Working Conditions
This is a permanent base role, with hybrid work arrangement (2 days remote + 3 days from office) and open to candidates in Melbourne that have full working right/visa.
Hybrid work model (on-site client meetings as required). Some interstate travel may be required based on client needs.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.

- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.

- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.

A Building Associate supervises construction sites and organises and coordinates the material and human resources required for a project.

Role Overview
Phoeniks is seeking an experienced Building Associate to supervise and coordinate the construction-related aspects of its ventilated ceiling installation projects nationally. The role sits within Phoeniks' technical and construction supervision function, assisting Construction Managers, Architects and Engineers in the planning, feasibility assessment, and on-site delivery of ventilated ceiling works across commercial, healthcare and institutional projects.

The successful candidate will act as Phoeniks' supervising construction sites, coordinating labour and materials, interpreting plans and codes, and ensuring works are feasible, compliant, and delivered to specification.

Key Responsibilities
1. Assisting Construction Managers, Architects and Surveyors in Planning and Organisation
- Support Construction Managers, Architects and Engineers in planning and organising ventilated ceiling works, including sequencing, access and integration with the broader head-contractor construction program
- Provide technical input during project planning, value engineering and problem-solving stages, working closely with the Product Manager and Technical Manager

2. Interpreting Plans, Regulations and Codes of Practice
- Read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications and construction documentation for ventilated ceiling installations
- Interpret and apply Australian Standards, building codes, and WHS regulations relevant to ceiling and building services works

3. Preparing Preliminary Sketches, Working Drawings and Specifications
- Prepare preliminary installation sketches and site-specific working drawings for ventilated ceiling systems
- Develop method statements and installation specifications tailored to individual site conditions

4. Preparing, Editing and Revising Plans, Maps, Charts and Drawings
- Edit and revise installation drawings, ceiling layout plans and services coordination charts in response to site conditions, clashes or design changes
- Liaise with the Product Manager – Ventilated Ceilings on drawing updates arising from product-specific requirements or site variations

5. Coordinating Works Programs
- Coordinate ventilated ceiling installation programs and sequencing across multiple sites nationally, aligning with the head contractor's overall construction program
- Supervise and support installation teams and subcontractors to ensure correct methods, sequencing and workmanship
- Assist with commissioning and handover activities as required

6. Inspecting Work and Materials for Compliance with Specifications, Regulations and Standards
- Attend project sites to inspect in-progress and completed works, ceiling structures, and materials for compliance with drawings, specifications and Australian Standards
- Conduct quality checks, identify defects, risks or required rework, and provide clear technical feedback to internal teams
- Ensure all site activities comply with WHS regulations, site safety plans and Phoeniks procedures

7. Calculating Costs and Estimating Time Scales
- Estimate installation time scales, labour requirements and material costs for ventilated ceiling projects, feeding into project programs and budgets
- Assess the technical feasibility of proposed installations prior to project confirmation, identifying risks, constraints and cost implications for internal teams

8. Collecting Data Using Surveying Instruments and Photogrammetric Equipment
- Collect on-site measurement and survey data — levels, dimensions, structural grid and services coordination data — using appropriate surveying and measuring instruments
- Record site conditions using photographic and measurement-based survey methods to support pre- installation feasibility assessments

9. Performing Routine Computations and Plotting Preliminary Data
- Perform routine dimensional, load and quantity computations to support installation drawings and material take-offs
- Plot preliminary layout and survey data to inform installation planning and drawing preparation

Training & Knowledge Transfer
- Train Phoeniks installation teams and subcontractors nationally on ventilated ceiling systems, promoting best-practice installation methods and quality standards across all regions
- Develop and deliver practical, on-site and workshop-based training sessions

Essential
- Relevant qualification or at least three years of relevant industry experience
- Proven experience supervising construction sites, ceiling systems, HVAC-related installations, or building services installations
- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications and construction documentation
- Strong understanding of site conditions, services coordination and construction sequencing
- Ability to collect and interpret site survey/measurement data and perform routine technical computations
- Willingness and ability to travel nationally on a regular basis
- Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with Construction Managers, Architects, Engineers and internal teams

- Experience working on healthcare, commercial, or large-scale construction projects

result.description:
Weldworks is hiring a Full-time Construction Project Manager role in West Ryde, NSW. Apply now to be part of our team.

Requirements for this role:

Flexible hours available
2–3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
WELDWORKS PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Construction Project Manager for our client’s construction projects, including residential homes, commercial buildings, civil works and public spaces in Sydney.
On a full-time basis, you will be responsible for planning, organising, directing, controlling and coordinating construction projects, as well as managing the physical, financial and human resources involved in the construction process.

Title: Construction Project Manager, Full-time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person
We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:

Requirements
•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Construction Project Management, Construction Management, Building Technology, Building Science, Civil Engineering or another highly relevant field. 
•	At least 2–3 years of relevant experience managing residential, commercial, industrial or civil construction projects. 
•	Demonstrated experience managing construction schedules, budgets, labour, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Strong knowledge of construction methods, building legislation, Australian Standards, quality requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Ability to read, assess and interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, specifications and construction contracts. 
•	Experience coordinating architects, engineers, consultants, subcontractors, suppliers, tradespeople and relevant authorities. 
•	Strong understanding of tendering, procurement, contract administration and project cost control. 
•	Ability to identify project risks, delays and budget variations and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. 
•	Excellent organisational, reporting and problem-solving abilities. 
•	Current Australian driver licence preferred. 
•	Relevant registration, licence or site accreditation may be required depending on the project and scope of work. 

Construction Project Manager Responsibilities
•	Plan, organise, direct, control and coordinate construction projects from commencement through to completion. 
•	Establish project plans, construction schedules, milestones, budgets and resource requirements. 
•	Interpret architectural drawings, engineering plans, technical specifications and contractual requirements. 
•	Determine appropriate construction methods, sequencing, labour requirements, materials, plant and equipment. 
•	Coordinate the procurement and delivery of construction materials, equipment and services. 
•	Consult with architects, engineers, building professionals, consultants, tradespeople and technical workers. 
•	Negotiate and communicate with building owners, property developers, clients, suppliers and subcontractors. 
•	Prepare, review and contribute to tenders, quotations, contract bids and project proposals. 
•	Implement coordinated work programs across construction sites. 
•	Monitor project progress, expenditure, quality, safety, risk and compliance against approved plans and budgets. 
•	Ensure construction activities comply with relevant building legislation, Australian Standards, contractual requirements and workplace health and safety procedures. 
•	Manage and monitor the performance, quality and progress of contractors and subcontractors. 
•	Arrange the submission of plans, permits and supporting documents to relevant authorities. 
•	Coordinate required inspections, approvals and project handover activities. 
•	Prepare progress reports, budget updates, risk assessments and project documentation. 
•	Identify potential delays, cost overruns, quality issues and construction risks and implement appropriate corrective actions. 
•	Lead and supervise site managers, project engineers, supervisors, forepersons, subcontractors and tradespeople as required. 
•	Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders throughout the construction process. 
•	Ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget and in accordance with the required quality standards. 

These responsibilities reflect the official ANZSCO functions for Construction Project Managers, including management of construction 
schedules, procurement, contractors, budgets, compliance, inspections and project resources. 
If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule a time to discuss the position available and determine whether the role is suitable for your qualifications and experience.
Work Location: In person

Global Vision Recruitment on Behalf of Loginet Technologies Pty Ltd

Date Posted: 13th July 2026

Position: ICT Project Manager (ANZSCO 135112)

Salary: $100,000 – $125,000 per annum plus Superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Mode: Full-Time, Permanent

Location: 217 Margaret St, Toowoomba City QLD 4350

Experience required: Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects

About Loginet Technologies

Loginet Technologies is an Australian technology consulting and digital transformation company committed to helping businesses leverage innovative technologies to improve efficiency, productivity, and sustainable growth. We deliver end-to-end ICT solutions across managed IT services, cloud computing, cybersecurity, software and mobile application development, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent business automation, DevOps, enterprise networking, telecommunications, digital transformation, infrastructure management, ERP and CRM solutions, and managed technology support. Our experienced team works closely with organisations across diverse industries to design, implement, integrate, and support secure, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions that drive business innovation and operational excellence.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced ICT Project Manager to lead the successful planning, execution and delivery of complex ICT projects across software development, AI solutions, business automation, cloud services, cybersecurity and digital transformation initiatives.

Working closely with clients, business stakeholders and multidisciplinary technical teams, you will manage the complete project lifecycle, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the complete lifecycle of ICT projects from initiation through planning, execution, implementation and closure.

•	Lead software development, cloud migration, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, intelligent automation and digital transformation projects.

•	Collaborate with clients to gather business requirements and translate them into successful project outcomes.

•	Develop project plans, budgets, schedules, milestones and resource allocation plans.

•	Coordinate cross-functional teams including software developers, AI engineers, cloud architects, infrastructure engineers, business analysts and cybersecurity specialists.

•	Manage Agile, Scrum and hybrid project delivery methodologies.

•	Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, issues and quality standards while ensuring successful project delivery.

•	Facilitate project workshops, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, stakeholder meetings and executive reporting.

•	Manage project governance, change requests, risk mitigation and quality assurance activities.

•	Coordinate with third-party vendors and technology partners to support successful project implementation.

•	Ensure successful deployment, client acceptance, knowledge transfer and operational handover following project completion.

•	Continuously improve project management processes and delivery frameworks across the organisation.

Essential Qualifications & Experience

•	Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a closely related ICT discipline.

•	Minimum three (3) years' experience managing ICT or software development projects.

•	Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise software, cloud, infrastructure or digital transformation projects.

•	Experience managing Agile and Scrum software development projects.

•	Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

•	Excellent leadership, communication and organisational abilities.

•	Experience managing project budgets, schedules, risks and multidisciplinary project teams.

•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Desirable Skills

•	Experience delivering AI, Generative AI or intelligent automation projects.

•	Experience with workflow automation platforms including n8n, Microsoft Power Automate, Make.com or similar technologies.

•	Knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or hybrid cloud environments.

•	Understanding of cybersecurity, enterprise networking and managed IT services.

•	Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Trello, Monday.com or similar project management platforms.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP), PRINCE2, Scrum Master or Agile certifications.

Why Join Loginet Technologies?

At Loginet Technologies, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative projects involving Artificial Intelligence, enterprise software development, intelligent automation, cloud computing, cybersecurity and digital transformation. We foster a collaborative and innovative workplace where employees are encouraged to develop their technical expertise, contribute to meaningful client outcomes and build long-term careers within a growing Australian technology company.

We offer:

•	Competitive remuneration package

•	Ongoing professional development and certification support

•	Flexible working arrangements

•	Exposure to enterprise cloud, AI and digital transformation projects

•	Career progression opportunities

•	Supportive and collaborative team culture

Interested applicant may submit their application to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Database Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the design, implementation, and ongoing management of our database systems. The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring the integrity, security, and performance of organisational data assets. This role suits a proactive and technically proficient professional with a strong background in database management and a commitment to delivering reliable, high-quality data infrastructure. Experience working within a collaborative IT environment and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders will be highly regarded.
## Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain database architecture, data structures, tables, and naming conventions to ensure the accuracy, consistency, and completeness of all data master files
- Establish, monitor, and maintain backup and recovery procedures, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption in the event of a system failure
- Implement and enforce database security protocols, integrity controls, and access management policies to safeguard sensitive organisational data
- Administer and maintain comprehensive database documentation, including guidelines, policies, and operational procedures, ensuring these remain current and fit for purpose
- Plan and perform database upgrades, patches, and migrations, including thorough testing, debugging, and issue resolution in accordance with approved quality assurance processes
- Monitor database performance on an ongoing basis, identifying bottlenecks and implementing tuning, indexing, and optimisation strategies to maximise efficiency
- Collaborate with developers, systems analysts, and business stakeholders to translate data requirements into effective and scalable database solutions
- Analyse existing database systems and workflows, recommending and implementing improvements to enhance reliability, performance, and maintainability
- Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance for database-related incidents, working to resolve issues promptly and minimise operational impact
- Ensure database environments comply with relevant data governance frameworks, privacy legislation, and organisational standards, including alignment with Australian Privacy Principles where applicable
- Assist in capacity planning activities by assessing current usage trends and forecasting future storage and performance requirements
- Support the development and maintenance of data integration processes, including ETL pipelines and data warehouse environments, in collaboration with cross-functional teams
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience
- Demonstrated experience in a Database Administrator or similar role, with hands-on responsibility for managing enterprise-level database environments
- Proficiency in one or more leading relational database management systems, such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL
- Strong working knowledge of SQL, including query writing, stored procedures, functions, and performance tuning
- Experience designing and implementing backup, recovery, and disaster recovery strategies in production environments
- Solid understanding of database security principles, including user access controls, encryption, and audit logging
- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex database performance issues through monitoring tools, execution plans, and indexing strategies
- Familiarity with data modelling techniques and the ability to translate business requirements into well-structured database designs
- Sound understanding of IT service management practices and experience working within structured change management processes
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a methodical approach to troubleshooting
- Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to liaise confidently with both technical teams and business stakeholders
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant vendor certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional, or equivalent
- Experience with cloud-based database platforms, including Azure SQL, Amazon RDS, or Google Cloud SQL
- Exposure to NoSQL database technologies such as MongoDB, Cassandra, or Redis
- Experience in data warehousing environments and familiarity with ETL tools and processes
- Knowledge of scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash for automation of routine database tasks
- Familiarity with DevOps practices and experience working within Agile or ITIL-aligned environments
- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as finance, healthcare, or government, with an understanding of associated compliance obligations
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a supportive and collaborative team culture that values continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development
- Access ongoing training opportunities, certification support, and clear pathways for career progression within a growing technology function
- Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options, to support a healthy work-life balance
- Work on meaningful, complex data challenges that have a genuine impact across the organisation
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with additional benefits including superannuation, annual leave loading, and access to an employee wellbeing programme
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
